assets.title: Clamp-On Flat-Jaw Bench Vise
assets.description: Original compact clamp-on flat-jaw bench vise with fixed rear jaw, separate front jaw, rectangular slide guide, visible screw and cross handles, and a continuous table-edge C frame with lower pressure pad. Seventeen editable closed parts in one fixed 80mm jaw opening and 50mm table gap. Actual unchanged worktable top/underside contact and original long stock side contact are checked with misplaced and overwide negative fixtures. Mounting datum is documented; no ground placement, screw motion, clamp force, cantilever stability or load rating is claimed.
